Migrate content and websites with confidence, minimize operational downtime, improve team collaboration and unlock the potential of your SharePoint environment for lasting business impact. Want to Learn More? Check out the answers of all the relevant sharepoint migration manager services queries you might have. What is SharePoint Migration Manager? It is the native Microsoft tool of the SharePoint admin center that assists in the migration of on-premises file shares and cloud sources content into the Microsoft 365 offering a centralized interface to create, schedule and monitor migration operations. It is designed to simplify large file share migrations to SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Teams, supporting multiple agents and task monitoring. What are its limitations? Migration Manager has certain limitations; it favors file share migrations and does not move SharePoint Server content directly; huge files above 250 GB are not supported; detailed automation and enhanced error correction are limited, and manual setup and monitoring are required in complex environments. Which is the best SharePoint migration tool? The best migration tool depends on your specific requirements. Migration Manager is better suited to large file share and multi-source migrations, whereas the SharePoint Migration Tool (SPMT) has been a preferred choice when it comes to moving SharePoint Server content to Microsoft 365. In more complex situations third-party tools like ShareGate are more advanced and have a richer metadata management and a better reporting capability, which means they are better suited to enterprises that require detailed control and extensive migration oversight. Where is the SharePoint migration tool? SharePoint Migration Tool (SPMT) is available by Microsoft’s official migration download pages and documentation within the Microsoft 365 admin center. It is also integrated in the SharePoint admin tools from where you can easily launch it for server-to-cloud migration projects. How do I migrate the sharepoint content? To perform a SharePoint content migration, begin by assessing your source environment, select the migration tool, (Migration Manager to file shares or SPMT to SharePoint Server), configure tasks with the source and the destination details, run the migration and validate the migrated content after migration. Efficient planning assists in minimizing mistakes and delays. Does Migration Manager support version history and metadata? Migration Manager is capable of migrating content precisely, however detailed metadata or versions of a SharePoint-specific platform may require tools like SPMT or other third-party applications, especially for lists, workflows, or custom elements. What is the duration of migration? The duration of migration is based on the size of the data, the network bandwidth and complexity. Large migrations may take days to weeks to complete and migrating off-peak can often improve migration because of Microsoft’s throttling behaviour. Is it possible to continue working during migration? Yes, modern migration tools allow users to keep using, auditing and reporting on SharePoint during migration, which helps maintain productivity and minimize the impact on daily operations. If you have any questions about SharePoint Migration Manager or need more information, don’t hesitate to reach out.
